title: Thai Kissed Curry
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai-inspired dish with a kissed of sweetness.

ingredients.name: Garlicky Chicken Breast
ingredients.notes: adjust cooking time according to preference

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together Thai Kissed Sauce and Curry Powder.
Season Garlicky Chicken Breast with salt and pepper.
Sear chicken in a hot skillet until browned on both sides.
Transfer skillet to oven and bake for 15-20 minutes or until cooked through.
While chicken is cooking, halve the Fresh Tomatoes and place them on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with a tablespoon of oil and season with salt and pepper.
Roast in the oven for 10-12 minutes or until tender.
Serve the chicken with roasted tomatoes and a drizzle of the Thai Kissed Sauce.
